title: Budino Di Ricotta
hookLine: Italian-inspired budino di ricotta with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Mash the ricotta and beat well with the egg yolks, stir in the flour, sugar, cinnamon, grated lemon rind and the rum and mix well. You can do this in a food processor. Beat the egg whites until stiff, fold in and pour into a buttered and floured 25cm cake tin. Bake in the oven at 180ºC/160ºC fan/gas 4 for about 40 minutes, or until it is firm. Incorporate {m52961_1}, {m52961_2}, {m52961_3}, and {m52961_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure ricotta first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Bake Budino Di Ricotta & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 30 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready. Incorporate {m52961_5}, {m52961_6}, {m52961_7}, and {m52961_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Serve hot or cold dusted with icing sugar. Let Budino Di Ricotta cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Budino Di Ricotta to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
